[center][color=#444444][size=1]Features[/size][/color][/center]
[b]Cornucopia - Fandom Foodie [/b]is a [b]configurable[/b] cooking recipes mod that adds several recipes from various media fandoms. Did you ever want to make a [b]Wonka Bar[/b] from Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, [b]Green Eggs and Ham[/b] from Dr. Seuss, or a [b]Krabby Patty[/b] from SpongeBob SquarePants? Do you covet the food from Spirited Away? Maybe you want to try your hand a finding a rare [b]Devil Fruit[/b]? This mod is for you!

This mod has a lite install (which adds about a dozen recipes) and a full install (which adds the rest)! Please choose the settings that appeal to you the most, based on your own personal playstyle. 

[b]Cornucopia - More Crops is required to play this mod[/b] (with any config options)[b].[/b]
Additionally, you will get 13 new recipes if you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url][/b] installed (optional).

Here are the main features:
[list]
[*]As many as[b] 81 new recipes[/b] (configurable) to discover - from sources spanning beloved fantasy books, to your favorite retro game, to a galaxy far, far away.[/*]
[/list][i]  ﻿If you want to see the full list of items and fandoms included in the mod, check out the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14vWFprO2lVPfLflKMXJyi50FrdaQYSek3YcKNhv4HFs/edit?usp=sharing]info spreadsheet[/url]!
[/i]
[list]
[*]New collectible items such as [b]Paopu Fruit, Spice Melange, Senzu Beans[/b], and more from foraging and monster loot.[/*]
[*]Obtain recipes from villager letters as you naturally progress the game (hint: each letter is linked to obtaining a new item), as well as from recipe books that can be purchased from different vendors.[/*]
[/list]
*[i]Recipes will automatically adjust to use ingredients from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cooking Recipes[/url]﻿ if they are installed - optional!
[/i]*[i]Cinnamon from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]More Crops[/url]﻿ will be forageable during winter, even if you don't have herbs enabled in More Crops.[/i]
[center]

[b][u][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#444444][size=1]setting up the mod﻿[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Extended Recipes Pack[/b] - For players who want the full mod experience, keep this option enabled for an additional 50+ fandom recipes. (With this option turned [b]off[/b], you will get 16 recipes included by default.)[/*]
[*][b]Enable Animal Husbandry Pack[/b] - If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]﻿ installed, unlock 13 more meat-based fandom recipes![/*]
[*][b]Enable Flexible Recipes[/b] - Freely swap out important cooking ingredients like Cheese, Oil, and more! (Recommend use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url]﻿.)[/*]
[*][b]Enable Extended Forage Pack[/b] - Adds a few fandom inspired forage items around the valley and beyond.[/*]
[/list][center]﻿

[color=#444444]Frequently asked questions[/color][/size][/center]
[b]Q: Can I install or uninstall this mod in an existing game?
A: Absolutely.[/b] This mod can be safely added or removed to any save file. You will not miss out on any content by adding it to an existing save. If you decide to remove the mod, any leftover items can be safely thrown away.

[b]Q: Are these recipes required for perfection?
A: Yes.[/b] Unfortunately, mod authors are currently unable to exclude cooking recipes from perfection requirements. However, [b]players can adjust their own perfection requirements,[/b] such as with the in-game perfection helping methods, or with the mod Perfection Tweaker.

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with [insert mod here]?[/b]
[b]A: Yes.[/b] Until someone reports otherwise, I do not know of any mods which are [i]incompatible[/i] with Cornucopia - Fandom Foodie.

[b]Q: I don't have all the other Cornucopia mods. Will I be missing out on content?[/b]
[b]A: Cornucopia - More Crops is required to play this mod, but that's it! [/b]However, you only need the most basic install of More Crops, rather than needing all the features enabled. You don't need any of the other parts of Cornucopia to enjoy this mod.

[b]Q: Can you make options to turn on or off specific recipes?
A: No. [/b]

[b]Q: Will you add [food] from [fandom]?
A: Maybe. [/b]While we're always open to suggestions, we can't add everything. If you feel we missed something truly iconic, please feel free to suggest it in our Discord. We mainly tried to focus on unique foods without a real-world analogue for this collection.

[b]Q: Can I help out?
A: Yes. [/b]We always especially need help from translators and wiki contributors! But, you can also give us feedback to improve our mods. Please leave a comment or [url=https://discord.gg/qEMWVcNPxe][b]join our Discord[/b][/url][b]. [/b]For questions and concerns over DMs, please contact 6480.
